About the Position

UWE Bristol participates in the South West Doctoral Training Partnership's ESRC studentship competition. The route supports social science research and uses the partnership's funding process alongside university admission, with project and academic preparation assessed during selection.

Research Areas

  • Social sciences
  • Research methods
  • Doctoral research

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryStipend offered; exact amount not stated

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityWorldwide, subject to programme rules
Further conditionsHome and international applicants; UWE covers eligible international fee difference.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round12 January 2027, noon GMT
LocationUnited Kingdom

About University of the West of England (UWE Bristol)

UWE Bristol offers postgraduate research through its schools and research centres. It participates in the South West Doctoral Training Partnership, which supports doctoral work in the social sciences.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

2026/27 UKRI reference rate: the minimum UKRI doctoral stipend is £21,805 per year, tax-free (London institutions +£2,000), effective 1 October 2026.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.uwe.ac.uk/research/postgraduate-research-study/studentships/south-west-doctoral-training-partnership

Source: uwe.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 12 January 2027, noon GMT - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 12 January 2027, noon GMT. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗
